basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Management Mumbai (IIM Mumbai)

application_fee.general_fee: Rs. 590/- (Rupees Five hundred Ninety only). SC, ST and PwBD are exempted. All internal candidates are exempted.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years as on the closing date for receipt of online applications. Age Relaxation: As per existing rules for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-serviceman.

qualification.details: Executive Assistant: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University or Institute. Five (05) years' relevant experience after the qualifying degree.

selection_process: Scrutiny/Screening of Applications Written test and/or skill test and/or interview and/or any other test/selection process
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Mumbai Executive Assistant Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Mumbai to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Executive Assistant post at IIM Mumbai?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Executive Assistant post at IIM Mumbai is 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Executive Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute to be eligible for the Executive Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Executive Assistant post announced by IIM Mumbai.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Executive Assistant post is 35 years as of the closing date for application submission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Executive Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Executive Assistant position will receive a salary as per Pay Level - 06 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Executive Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, a fee of Rs. 590/- is applicable for General/OBC candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, and Internal candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online through the official website of IIM Mumbai.

faq.question: Q8. What is the type of employment for the Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: The job is offered on a Tenure/Contract/Fixed Term basis.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIM Mumbai offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-serviceman candidates as per the existing government rules.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Executive Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny/screening of applications, followed by a written test and/or skill test and/or interview, or any other applicable selection method.
